sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and value-oriented sectors are showing solid underlying breadth, but momentum leaders like Industrials and Tech still hold the top ranks despite underlying fragility in newly strong groups.

Defensive and interest-rate-sensitive sectors are carving out a stronger footprint, with Healthcare, Real Estate, Financials, and Consumer Defensive all achieving "all-green" status across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD horizons. Industrials remains the overall momentum leader (0.733 momentum, rank 1), while Consumer Cyclical continues to anchor the bottom of the pack (0.267 momentum, rank 11).

Rotation is visible as Utilities and Energy falter, dropping two spots and one spot respectively. Meanwhile, Consumer Defensive and Healthcare are pushing upward, each gaining one spot in the rankings over the last five sessions. 

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Alignment:** Four out of 11 market sectors are currently "all-green" across all timeframes, signaling a healthy expansion of market participation.
* **Defensive & Financial Leadership:** The all-green cohort is led by Healthcare (0.68 momentum), followed by Real Estate (0.58 momentum), Financials (0.53 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.45 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Industrials (+1 spot, rank 1), Healthcare (+1 spot, rank 7), and Consumer Defensive (+1 spot, rank 6) showed the greatest ranking improvements over the last five sessions.
* **Top Losers:** Utilities experienced the sharpest decline, dropping 2 spots to rank 8 (0.30 momentum), while Energy slipped 1 spot to rank 2 (0.45 momentum).
* **Absolute Leaders:** Industrials (0.733) and Technology (0.633) maintain their positions as the top absolute momentum engines alongside Healthcare. 

## Divergences
* **Fragile All-Green Signals:** Despite their positive performance across all timeframes, Financials (agreement 0.30) and Healthcare (agreement 0.48) exhibit low agreement scores, indicating their current "all-green" status is highly unstable.
* **Rank vs. Momentum Disconnect:** Energy retains a high YTD rank at number 2, yet its momentum has faded to 0.450, placing it among the momentum laggards.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive healthcare and distribution industries are anchoring market strength, while a sharp rotation is lifting consumer electronics and publishing at the expense of commodities and solar.

The US market exhibits healthy underlying breadth, with 36 of 144 industry groups maintaining "all-green" status across all timeframes. Healthcare is the clear leadership anchor, driven by sustained strength in REIT - Healthcare Facilities and Healthcare Plans. Meanwhile, a powerful weekly rotation is underway as tech-adjacent and consumer services sectors surge up the rankings, contrasted by a swift retreat in industrial materials and energy transition plays.

At the bottom of the performance spectrum, momentum continues to decay for deep laggards. Utilities - Independent Power Producers and Paper & Paper Products remain pinned to the bottom of the momentum curve, failing to find a bid as capital flows toward more defensive healthcare conglomerates and newly emerging consumer plays.

## Strength
* **Healthcare Dominance:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.84), Biotechnology (0.84), and Healthcare Plans (0.83) lead the 36 all-green industries, showing sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
* **Broad-Based Leaders:** Food Distribution (momentum 0.83) and Financial Conglomerates (0.80) join the top tier of all-green performers with robust YTD backing.
* **Tech and Industrial Anchors:** Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (momentum 0.80) and Textile Manufacturing maintain their positions as sustained long-term strength leaders.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Rapid Climbers:** Consumer Electronics jumped 33 spots to rank 56 (momentum 0.70), while Publishing and Staffing & Employment Services both surged 27 spots.
* **Sharp Decliners:** Aluminum plunged 28 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.34), followed closely by Department Stores (down 25 spots to rank 107) and Solar (down 24 spots to rank 101).
* **Severe Laggards:** Utilities - Independent Power Producers remains the weakest industry in the market with a momentum score of 0.09, followed closely by Paper & Paper Products at 0.14.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Airlines (momentum 0.75) and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.69) are showing early signs of exhaustion, slipping 4 spots each over the last 5 sessions despite high momentum scores.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Education & Training Services (rank +13, momentum 0.46) and Electronic Gaming & Multimedia (rank +10, momentum 0.46) are climbing rapidly despite their currently low momentum profiles.
* **Fragile All-Green Groups:** Medical Care Facilities (agreement 0.45) and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (agreement 0.49) exhibit low internal agreement scores, making their all-green status highly unstable.
